statement.zh: Flad 2018 ARA 论文以「城市化即技术」框架讨论中国早期城市化（含成都平原关联）。
statement.en: Flad 2018 ARA paper discusses early Chinese urbanism under an “urbanism as technology” framework (Chengdu Plain relevance).
